programmes.d: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator.
Mechanic Cory races against the clock to turn two short-haul waterbombers into trans-Atlantic aircraft for the epic journey to Turkey.
Joe loses it after an operational screw-up. Devan ponders a job offer, while Jynelle ponders their future.
A furious Joe fights the feds when his daily flight is suspended. An unexpected injury shakes up the rampies. The waterbomber crew sets off on the risky cross-Canada leg of their journey to Turkey.
A potentially dangerous leak, a sobering survival course and a tragic crash rattle the Turkey waterbomber crew.
Engine failure en route to Portugal forces one Turkey crew to negotiate a treacherous return to Santa Maria. Mikey and Scott search for a new rampie.
Crews race against the spring melt to fly mining equipment to an airstrip on a frozen lake. En route to Turkey, Arnie and Justin face some serious volcanoes and massive Mediterranean air traffic.

After thousands of hours of painstaking preparation and risky flying, a terrible accident devastates the waterbomber crew in Turkey. And in Yellowknife, Wilf’s first run as flight attendant causes consternation.
When her husband walks out after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. And Scott must stand down from flying to fast-track a rival co-pilot.
Kelly confronts husband Juan and comes to a decision about her future at Buffalo. Jeremy makes a mistake that could end his career, and fate throws Scott an unexpected curve ball.
Marc's run to "far out" Roswell leaves him proud to be from this world, while Todd and Tamera end up needing more than a few quarters to extend their vintage game pod run.
Things melt down, when Jenn tackles the dismantling of a butter sculpture in the Texas heat, while Jessica Samko makes her stage debut.
It's a clash of egos when Marc and Jarrett find that both of their shipments are headed to the same drop off.
Jenn learns that Roy Garber's "perfect, just like me" was more than a catch-phrase when she's tasked with transporting a load that was once shipped by the legend...
Marc is weighed down by a load that might just be more than the Snortin' Boar can tackle. Meanwhile, Dusty gets stuck hauling some very unique art.

Jessica signs up to move a half-ton steampunk robot in a single day, but will bad weather turn her load into steamjunk? Todd and Tamera realize that moonshine stills and porcelain plates don't mix well in the back of a trailer.
A shipment of medical equipment takes a turn for the weird when Jenn learns her load is a LOT different than expected.
Jarrett, single-handedly almost ruins the west coast art scene when he hauls an odd sculpture to its various photo shoot locations in the Bay area.
Jessica finds herself asking a LOT of questions after she agrees to transport a seller's loved one named Bruce.
Todd and Tamera take on some Monsters in a move that proves to be anything but cinematic.
A giant dog toy has Todd and Tamera chasing their tails as they try to navigate trailer issues and engine trouble.
Marc takes on an antique camper and Dusty transports a sculpture.
Mike participates in the annual Pageant of the Masters festival where he helps bring Leonardo da Vinci's painting "The Last Supper” to life.
Mike meets a French entrepreneur and chef who uses traditional Mennonite farming methods to produce a better tasting chicken.
Mike visits Disaster City to train with first responders in preparation for any sort of global catastrophe.
Mike visits a wild life and research institute with the some abnormal methods for saving endangered birds.
Mike meets a former hippie turned successful entrepreneur who is rethinking the dairy farm and making delicious goat cheese.
Mike meets an artist who is changing the look of his hometown of Austin, Texas with beautiful neon folk art.
Mike witnesses the back stage magic at one of the biggest shows in Las Vegas and meets the man responsible for it all.
Mike visits a museum dedicated to hair and its charming curator. Then Mike meets a hairstylist who has found the perfect canvas is man’s best friend.
Mike visits a medical museum and meets the historical record keeper of the human body in all of its glory, suffering, pain, and splendor.
Mike meets the man who is pulling millions of pounds of trash from America’s waterways.
Mike travels to the inhospitable desert to learn the art of survival and make amends for his television past.
Mike visits a Texas town obsessed with Watermelons and seed spitting. He then meets a world champion barista who explains the power of the coffee bean.
Mike visits a legacy marching and drum line in Kansas City that’s giving kids a chance at a better future.
Mike helps turn 40 dump trucks of dirt into a Monster Jam track at Harris Bradley Arena in Milwaukee, then test drives the legendary Max D monster truck.
Mike meets carpenters Adam Dick and Dustin Taylor, who used their love of chocolate and old, second-hand equipment to turn their lumberyard into a chocolate factory.
Mike attends the PBR in Chicago, Illinois, to train and work as a bull fighter.
Justin and his crew are stranded with a frozen plane in the High Arctic.
When a deadly fire destroys a northern outpost a week before Christmas, Kelly puts aside her personal dilemmas to rally Buffalo to the rescue.
